jcr:content.shortDescription: A wooded limestone valley with steep paths and open grassland above.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Goblin Combe has a dramatic contrast between shaded woodland and the grasslands on higher ground. This is a reserve for families who enjoy more demanding walks and can give the terrain their full attention.

Our family idea: compare the light, temperature and sounds in the wooded valley with an open section of your chosen route. Pick a manageable walk from the reserve information and turn back before anyone is tired.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Older children and families experienced on steep woodland paths.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Nature-reserve footpaths; carry your own refreshments.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Parking on Cleeve Hill Road is limited; follow the reserve's access guidance.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Access is steep, with steps and muddy paths. Stay away from cliffs and scree slopes; this is not a buggy route.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Goblin Combe, Cleeve Hill Road, Cleeve, BS49 4PH
placevisitmap.travelNote: Parking on Cleeve Hill Road is limited; follow the reserve's access guidance. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
